fault_line: Did Trump really stop a nuclear weapon -- or is this a victory lap after the midterms? The claim vs the record.

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Trump's own words, VERIFIED as posted] 'Israel and, in fact, the entire Middle East, WOULD NOT EXIST TODAY if I did not stop Iran from having a Nuclear Weapon. Nobody wants to say that, but everybody knows it's true!' (Truth Social, Friday Nov 6; quoted verbatim by Times of India, Times Now, Tribune India/ANI). CONTEXT: Trump met his national security team Wed-Thu on whether to resume major operations against Iran; a US official said CENTCOM is finalising preparations, no formal orders issued; Fox News notes Nov 9 is a new moon (minimal moonlight, advantageous for operations) -- new-moon detail already recorded. CENTCOM posted an image of an A-10 Thunderbolt II preparing for take-off at a Middle East base on Friday. Trump spoke with Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani by phone Friday on easing tensions (Qatari ruler's media office). Iraqi PM Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi told Trump by phone Thursday that Iraqi territory must not be used to launch attacks on neighbouring countries. [NOTE] The underlying assertion -- that Trump personally stopped an Iranian nuclear weapon and thereby saved Israel/the Middle East -- is presented with no evidence in the post; Iran's nuclear status remains disputed and no independent verification of the claim exists. Record the quote, not the boast, as fact.
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct declared-tier publisher families: ANI (T1 wire, via Tribune India) + Times of India (T3). Times Now carries the same quote. The post itself is the primary source (Trump's own account).
sections.what_disputed: No evidence is presented in the post for the claim that Iran was about to obtain a nuclear weapon or that the region would have ceased to exist. Trump himself said Oct 15/16 (Newsmax, via Anadolu) 'No, I wouldn't use nuclear. We don't have to.' -- the MOAB, not a nuclear weapon, was the option named. CENTCOM has issued no order for resumed major operations.
sections.why_matters: Trump says the entire Middle East would not exist today without him. The same week his generals finish plans for new strikes -- and the moon goes dark on November 9.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- Trump Truth Social: 'Israel and, in fact, the entire Middle East, WOULD NOT EXIST TODAY if I did not stop Iran from having a Nuclear Weapon'

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump says the entire Middle East would not exist today without him. The same week his generals finish plans for new strikes -- and the moon goes dark on November 9. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Did Trump really stop a nuclear weapon -- or is this a victory lap after the midterms? The claim vs the record.
